# Hook: check-handoff-staleness

Verify the Product Handoff is still current before implementation work begins on an SDD change.

GitHub Copilot has no hook runtime, so this guard is documentation: run the commands
below yourself (or in CI) at the described moments.

## before-implementation

```bash
product-definition handoff status ${handoff}
```

Staleness is judged only by the digests of referenced artifacts; unrelated repository activity never blocks.
